scope: As-built source audit of active OpenAI path; optional legacy interfaces explicitly labelled.

flows.title: Open a session and connect voice
flows.subtitle: HTTP creates setup state; the client WebSocket and provider WebSocket are separate connections.
flows.note: The native app sends a bearer pairing token; it does not call /api/pair. Health reports configuration, not funded access. A voice_ready event, not socket open, enables microphone sending.

steps.label: POST /api/onboarding
steps.detail: JSON: device, capture_supported (LiDAR), camera_supported.

steps.label: Create bounded in-memory setup session
steps.detail: Expire/consume old sessions; at most 8 live setup sessions; TTL 600 s.

steps.label: 200 {id, expires_in_s: 600}
steps.detail: Alternative: 409 conversation limit; common auth/schema errors apply.

steps.label: GET /api/health
steps.detail: Read advertised OpenAI voice transport/readiness; no provider request.

steps.label: 200 capability/configuration JSON
steps.detail: Require voice_transport=realtime, assistant_provider=openai, realtime_ready=true.

steps.label: WS /api/onboarding/{id}/live
steps.detail: Authenticated WebSocket handshake; startVoice:false in native client.

steps.label: WebSocket accepted; listener attached
steps.detail: Independent event sender; stored setup events may be replayed.

steps.label: Prepare AVAudioEngine and event tasks
steps.detail: Settle voice-processing audio graph before asking for paid voice.

steps.label: start_voice
steps.detail: JSON control event; await voice_ready or voice_error, not an HTTP reply.

steps.label: Select OpenAILiveBridge and claim voice owner
steps.detail: A second voice owner gets voice_error; event socket can remain open.

steps.label: WSS api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=...
steps.detail: Server credential; configured gpt-realtime-2.1 in submission configuration.

steps.label: session.update
steps.detail: 24 kHz PCM, Marin, semantic VAD, tools, asynchronous input transcription.

steps.label: session.updated
steps.detail: Provider acknowledges configuration; wait bounded to 20 s.

steps.label: voice_ready (via FastAPI event sender)
steps.detail: Server enqueues voice_ready and requests the greeting; native enables microphone when voice_ready arrives.

flows.title: Spoken setup, readiness and capture handoff
flows.subtitle: Tool requests are provider events; the server validates them and changes setup state in process.
flows.note: Confirmation intent is model-interpreted. Code enforces later intelligible owner turns, gate versions and matching arguments; playback must cover readback and readiness. Preview may run, evidence capture does not.

steps.label: response.function_call_arguments.done
steps.detail: present_setup: language, country, currency, capture_mode, prompt templates.

steps.label: Validate presented preferences and owner turn
steps.detail: Render readback server-side; select LiDAR when supported, otherwise camera.

steps.label: conversation.item.create + response.create
steps.detail: Function output by call_id; spoken full readback requested with tools disabled.

steps.label: Assistant audio via bridge and API
steps.detail: response.output_audio.delta -> audio; transcript/done tracked separately.

steps.label: playback via API: actual played_ms
steps.detail: Audio completion + output transcript + played coverage open confirmation gate.

steps.label: Later owner turn: configure_session
steps.detail: Matching preferences with confirmed:true after delivered readback.

steps.label: Store confirmed preferences in memory
steps.detail: Onboarding session only; emit setup_confirmed and schedule separate readiness question.

steps.label: setup_confirmed {preferences}; readiness audio
steps.detail: Phone acknowledges actual readiness-question playback before next gate.

steps.label: Later owner turn: request_capture {ready:true}
steps.detail: Validate readiness phase, intelligible turn and physical sensor capability.

steps.label: capture_requested via API
steps.detail: Native closes onboarding voice/events before creating the sweep.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps
steps.detail: JSON: device, onboarding_id. Retry lookup first checks persisted handoff.

steps.label: Consume setup and copy preferences / usage
steps.detail: Persist onboarding_id with new sweep; close setup voice, refresh copied usage.

steps.label: 200 ClaimPacket snapshot
steps.detail: Same onboarding ID recovers existing sweep; invalid/expired handoff is 409.

steps.label: Start shared AR/RoomPlan session
steps.detail: Create capture outbox and clock; choose mode from returned sweep state.

steps.label: WS /api/sweeps/{id}/live
steps.detail: New sweep event connection; a new start_voice follows F01 provider setup.

steps.label: inventory {packet}; later voice_ready
steps.detail: Initial snapshot is independent of new provider voice readiness.

flows.title: Stream audio, acknowledge playback and interrupt
flows.subtitle: Audio and transcript events stream asynchronously; generation completion does not prove playback.
flows.note: The active protocol has no sequential STT -> text model -> TTS chain. Input transcription assists action gates asynchronously. No routine uploaded JPEG is forwarded to Realtime. Disconnect does not erase saved capture evidence. Native audio and inventory share one client WebSocket; the gateway owns a separate provider WebSocket.

steps.label: audio {pcm_base64}
steps.detail: Signed PCM16 mono at 16 kHz; microphone enabled only after voice_ready.

steps.label: Validate and enqueue audio
steps.detail: Even byte count; at most 32,000 bytes per native audio event.

steps.label: input_audio_buffer.append {audio}
steps.detail: Stateful resampling to 24 kHz; provider VAD controls ordinary turn creation.

steps.label: input_audio_buffer.speech_started / speech_stopped / committed
steps.detail: Independent transcription.completed and response events follow.

steps.label: response.output_audio.delta
steps.detail: PCM16 mono 24 kHz plus response/item/content identifiers.

steps.label: audio via API event socket
steps.detail: pcm_base64, sample_rate=24000, item_id, content_index, audio_end_ms.

steps.label: Schedule playback on AVAudioPlayerNode
steps.detail: Track cumulative played duration with dataPlayedBack callbacks.

steps.label: playback via API
steps.detail: item_id, content_index, played_ms: receipt of audio actually played.

steps.label: Transcript and response.done events
steps.detail: Forward transcript / turn_complete separately; record reported usage.

steps.label: ALT manual: interrupt_voice
steps.detail: Phone stops queued playback and temporarily suppresses late audio.

steps.label: Handle interruption request
steps.detail: Spoken barge-in instead starts from provider input_audio_buffer.speech_started.

steps.label: interrupted via API
steps.detail: Publish interrupted first; invalidate pending work and clear stale playback state.

steps.label: response.cancel; conversation.item.truncate
steps.detail: Manual: response.cancel only if active; truncate only when an unplayed audio tail exists.

steps.label: Optional stop_voice
steps.detail: Close provider bridge while retaining event-only socket where possible.

steps.label: ALT unrecovered provider failure: voice_error
steps.detail: Sanitized reconnect/billing guidance; preserve usage and review reason.

flows.title: Select, retain and upload camera evidence
flows.subtitle: An HTTP receipt acknowledges immutable admission or suppression. Recognition completes later (F05).
flows.note: The phone retains acknowledged bytes. Same-ID retries cannot change metadata/calibration. Similar-image suppression stores metadata, not a second JPEG; exact RGB plus new depth may queue geometry-only refinement.

steps.label: Local detector proposals + quality + fingerprint
steps.detail: Core ML full frame/detail crops; display provisional dotted outlines.

steps.label: Apply selection and concurrency gates
steps.detail: Tracking, blur/exposure, novelty, pending count, time interval, depth improvement.

steps.label: Encode selected frame and run Vision OCR
steps.detail: Raw-axis JPEG + calibration/pose + OCR; LiDAR depth/confidence if supported.

steps.label: Encoded FrameUpload payload
steps.detail: local_analysis=cloud_requested/unavailable; no Apple language model call.

steps.label: Atomically save pending/{frame_id}.json
steps.detail: Immutable bytes before network; 1 GB outbox budget.

steps.label: Earliest pending frame payload
steps.detail: One uploader sends saved frames sequentially; retries reuse exact bytes.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/frames
steps.detail: metadata, jpeg_base64, depth_base64, confidence_base64; bearer auth.

steps.label: Validate payload and compute receipt signature
steps.detail: Dimensions, image/depth lengths, same AR session and capture state.

steps.label: Persist evidence, receipt and queued state
steps.detail: New frames enter bounded queue; JPEG content is hash-addressed.

steps.label: 200 {accepted:true, processing:"queued", ...}
steps.detail: duplicate:false and queue_depth for new frames; not a recognition result.

steps.label: Move pending file to uploaded/
steps.detail: Preserve bytes; accepted frame unlocks live geometry upload.

steps.label: ALT full queue: 429 + Retry-After: 3
steps.detail: detail.processing=retry_backpressure, accepted:false, retry_after_s:3.

steps.label: ALT retain pending; delay and retry same bytes
steps.detail: Other upload errors also retain pending evidence; no second frame ID.

steps.label: ALT duplicate: 200 with duplicate:true
steps.detail: processing=duplicate_suppressed or queued_geometry; original receipt may replay.

flows.title: Recognize a frame and publish inventory
flows.subtitle: Frame workers run concurrently; publication order can differ from capture order.
flows.note: Current phone produces no local semantic book clues; Open Library is a compatibility branch, not the normal current path. Quality/budget/cooldown can defer cloud. Model labels do not set dimensions or prices.

steps.label: Dequeue frame; read hash-verified JPEG
steps.detail: Duplicate-geometry job instead reuses source polygons with its own depth.

steps.label: Saved image + calibrated evidence
steps.detail: Receipt integrity establishes bytes, not recognition correctness.

steps.label: Resolve local OCR / proposal evidence
steps.detail: Apply independent text and detector support; optional catalogue lookup precedes cloud reservation.

steps.label: OPTIONAL GET openlibrary.org/search.json
steps.detail: Compatible book clues only: title, author, limit=3, selected metadata fields.

steps.label: OPTIONAL candidate bibliographic metadata
steps.detail: Corroboration only; catalogue ISBN/edition does not become observed evidence.

steps.label: Quality / novelty / budget / cooldown decision
steps.detail: Reserve and persist any cloud attempt before a billable provider request.

steps.label: POST /v1/responses (standard OpenAI base)
steps.detail: gpt-6-astra; upright selected JPEG + hints; store:false; strict ProposedScan.

steps.label: Completed parsed output + usage
steps.detail: Detections, polygons, visible text, quality issues, guidance; no price/scale authority.

steps.label: Validated scan + routing + quality
steps.detail: Restore raw-image coordinates; reject malformed individual polygons.

steps.label: Under lock: geometry, association and apply_scan
steps.detail: Measure sensor-supported faces; match physical records; gate book identity on OCR.

steps.label: Save observation/overlays; revise state
steps.detail: Increment revision, persist immutable refs and atomic state; queue eligible prices.

steps.label: inventory {packet} via API WebSocket
steps.detail: Full saved snapshot, including usage/cost estimate and unresolved review entries.

steps.label: frame_overlays then recognition_status
steps.detail: Overlay geometry; status ready/pending, routing, cost and provisional objects.

steps.label: Optional guidance via API WebSocket
steps.detail: User-facing capture guidance, separate from structured voice context.

steps.label: offer_context: saved recognition facts
steps.detail: Grounded text context for Realtime (F03); no routine JPEG copied to voice.

steps.label: ALT deferred / provider failure / worker failure
steps.detail: Retain supported evidence; unknown usage is null; emit pending or unavailable status.

flows.title: Measure objects and update RoomPlan geometry
flows.subtitle: Object face measurements and room/furniture geometry use calibrated sensor evidence, not guessed model scale.
flows.note: Live RoomPlan intentionally omits floor polygons. Final RoomBuilder geometry is needed for floor area. Camera-only frames keep unsupported measurements unknown. Accurate sensor-derived numbers still need tape/ruler validation.

steps.label: For each scan polygon: measure detection
steps.detail: Use original calibration and confident aligned depth; fit local plane/rays.

steps.label: Dimensions / world support or unknown + reasons
steps.detail: Book spine edges or visible object face; no invented full 3-D box.

steps.label: Associate physical track and furniture anchor
steps.detail: Same session, one-to-one assignment, compatible category/depth/geometry.

steps.label: Existing physical ID or new/reviewable record
steps.detail: Text equality alone never merges physical objects; ambiguity stays explicit.

steps.label: RoomPlan live update on shared AR session
steps.detail: Throttle >=3 s; retain latest snapshot; only one geometry request in flight.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/geometry
steps.detail: After accepted frame: session ID, walls/openings/objects; live floors:[], capture_complete:false.

steps.label: Validate session and geometry write state
steps.detail: Camera mode, absent first frame or mismatched session reject; same bytes are idempotent.

steps.label: Save immutable geometry/room_<id>.json
steps.detail: Preserve the input geometry before reconciling measurements.

steps.label: measure_room + reconcile furniture
steps.detail: Floor/wall polygons, openings, wall height, supported RoomPlan boxes, one-to-one matches.

steps.label: Room facts / furniture dimensions / review issues
steps.detail: Curved or incomplete surfaces and ambiguous links preserve unknowns.

steps.label: Update state; refresh affected price queries
steps.detail: Clear obsolete dimensions on revision; stale quotes cannot apply.

steps.label: inventory {packet} via API WebSocket
steps.detail: Event update can arrive before the geometry HTTP response.

steps.label: offer_context: measurement facts
steps.detail: Optional grounded voice cue; this is an internal bridge call, not a phone event.

steps.label: 200 {saved:true}
steps.detail: 422 unsupported/session-invalid; 409 changed geometry after capture ended.

steps.label: At end, if available: POST final geometry
steps.detail: LiDAR RoomBuilder output before /finish; failures become capture issues and geometry may be skipped.

flows.title: Search, verify and apply a price
flows.subtitle: Pricing is a separate in-process queue. Search returns URLs; fetched source offers establish price evidence.
flows.note: Quote-cache hit skips network calls; search-cache hit skips only model search and still fetches/validates retailers. Caches/in-flight sharing are per runner. A quote has a 45 s deadline after semaphore entry. Unknown offers stay outside totals. API USD usage costs are separate from local-currency claim values.

steps.label: Enqueue eligible record + revision/fingerprint
steps.detail: Books: new and used separately; items: new only. No repeat of unchanged attempted job.

steps.label: Set queued -> searching; save/publish inventory
steps.detail: Check eligibility, current revision, paid-pricing setting and provider latch.

steps.label: Check quote/search cache and shared in-flight task
steps.detail: Quote cache skips network; search cache skips model search only. Per-runner caches; raw current query validated.

steps.label: POST /v1/responses with web_search
steps.detail: gpt-5.4-mini, country/currency/condition query, required search, one tool call.

steps.label: Completed search citations/sources + usage
steps.detail: Up to eight candidate URLs; generated price prose is not accepted.

steps.label: GET discovered public product URLs
steps.detail: Fetch candidates concurrently; revalidate redirects/addresses; timeout/size limits.

steps.label: HTML/text containing JSON-LD Product/Book Offer
steps.detail: No fixed retailer pricing API; blocked/unstructured sources may give no usable offer.

steps.label: Validate and rank individual offers
steps.detail: Identity, condition, stock, market/currency, material/dimensions and retrieval date.

steps.label: OPTIONAL foreign-market fallback search
steps.detail: If local sources fail, search UK/GBP or India/INR; repeat retrieval/validation.

steps.label: OPTIONAL GET /v2/rate/{base}/{quote}
steps.detail: Foreign conversion and non-INR appraisal-threshold check; pair cache may satisfy.

steps.label: JSON {base, quote, date, rate}
steps.detail: Validate dated positive rate and pair; preserve original amount/currency.

steps.label: QuoteResult with Price and source metadata
steps.detail: Or amount:null + explicit unavailable/timeout/access reason.

steps.label: Revalidate revision; persist offer/search/FX refs
steps.detail: Reject stale results; update pricing status; no automatic retry after uncertain spend.

steps.label: apply_quote -> save_publish -> optional bundle refresh
steps.detail: Later inventory event and valuation_updated voice context announce current state.

flows.title: Read inventory and apply corrections
flows.subtitle: Browser review pairs with a cookie; native HTTP uses a bearer token. Both can subscribe to the same event route.
flows.note: There is no SSE endpoint or durable event cursor. Listener overflow drops oldest events; GET or a new WebSocket snapshot recovers current state. Lazy-loading a saved sweep may resume eligible pricing, but not frame jobs.

steps.label: POST /api/pair {token}
steps.detail: Optional browser bootstrap; token supplied from review link fragment, then cleared.

steps.label: 200 {paired:true} + claim_pair cookie
steps.detail: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict; Secure only over HTTPS. Bad token: 401.

steps.label: GET /api/sweeps; GET /api/sweeps/{id}
steps.detail: List latest 20 saved entries; select one for a current snapshot.

steps.label: runner_for(id): lazy load if needed
steps.detail: After restart mark interrupted capture partial; resume eligible pricing only.

steps.label: 200 list / 200 ClaimPacket
steps.detail: Packet includes sweep, room, books/items, totals, review_queue, revision, metrics.

steps.label: WS /api/sweeps/{id}/live
steps.detail: Browser can stay event-only; it does not send start_voice.

steps.label: Initial inventory, then updated packets/events
steps.detail: Initial snapshot and later inventory use {type:"inventory",packet}.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/corrections
steps.detail: JSON: action, ref_id, value. Use an exact saved inventory/shelf ID.

steps.label: correct(): resolve alias, validate and revise
steps.detail: Invalidate affected price jobs/values; append owner claim/exclusion audit.

steps.label: Persist revised state and refresh finished bundle
steps.detail: Print confirmation may enable pricing; unsupported claims require appraisal.

steps.label: inventory {packet} via API
steps.detail: State publication occurs before the correction HTTP response.

steps.label: 200 updated ClaimPacket
steps.detail: Invalid reference/action: 422; identical correction is not automatically deduplicated.

steps.label: ALTERNATIVE voice: correct_inventory tool
steps.detail: Validated provider function event invokes the same method, not another HTTP service.

steps.label: Internal snapshot/result -> function_call_output
steps.detail: Tool result is sent back to Realtime by call_id; see F02/F03.

flows.title: Finish, generate and download claim evidence
flows.subtitle: The native client flushes saved evidence and final geometry before a held /finish request.
flows.note: Finish returns 200 only after drain/deadline handling; it is not a 202 job receipt. Partial can still be a successful HTTP outcome. Exports may also be requested before finish. Comparison is not automatically inside packet.zip.

steps.label: Stop sampling; LiDAR RoomBuilder if supported
steps.detail: Await encoder; save final geometry if available; drain pending uploads for up to 60 s.

steps.label: ALT pending evidence remains: Awaiting uploads
steps.detail: Expose Retry finish; do not call server finish while pending files remain.

steps.label: If available: POST /geometry after live drain
steps.detail: Send final LiDAR geometry when present; camera or failed export skips it with capture issues.

steps.label: 200 {saved:true}
steps.detail: Require success when geometry exists; otherwise finalize with recorded geometry-failure issues.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/finish
steps.detail: duration_s and capture_issues; native request timeout 300 s.

steps.label: finish_lock; transition to processing
steps.detail: Already ready/partial returns snapshot. Otherwise save/publish processing state.

steps.label: Await frame queue, then price queue
steps.detail: Workers run concurrently; bounded overall finish_timeout, source default 240 s.

steps.label: ALT deadline: cancel remaining workers
steps.detail: Mark unfinished pricing unknown/reviewable; continue to partial packet.

steps.label: Compute Decimal totals; save final state
steps.detail: Preserve ready/partial state, review queue and immutable evidence refs.

steps.label: inventory {packet} via API
steps.detail: Final snapshot is published before bundle generation; it does not prove the ZIP exists.

steps.label: Build bundle; update timing; save/rewrite bundle
steps.detail: Generate JSON, HTML and ZIP; then offer capture-ended context to internal voice bridge.

steps.label: packet_ready {packet} via API
steps.detail: Emitted after bundle generation; final HTTP response follows.

steps.label: 200 final/partial ClaimPacket
steps.detail: Held HTTP response completes; this does not prove all acceptance bars passed.

steps.label: GET /api/sweeps/{id}/packet.zip
steps.detail: Optional alternatives: claim_packet.json, report.html, evidence path.

steps.label: Rebuild bundle under lock; verify evidence hashes
steps.detail: ZIP includes packet/report/manifest and registered evidence, not raw state.json.

steps.label: 200 application/zip; filename claim_{id}.zip
steps.detail: Native saves local download; optional comparison starts afterwards (F10).

flows.title: Compare camera-only with LiDAR
flows.subtitle: Optional same-frame depth ablation: one held POST, persisted status reads, and a separate replay runner.
flows.note: This reuses JPEGs and AR poses, not source depth/geometry/identity/prices. Poses may have benefited from LiDAR. A complete workflow can contain partial/failed analysis; it is not an accuracy or sensor-speed benchmark.

steps.label: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/camera-comparison
steps.detail: JSON {}; native waits up to 300 s. Must follow eligible ready/partial LiDAR sweep.

steps.label: Acquire filesystem lock; inspect previous report
steps.detail: Existing completed/failed report returns without another replay.

steps.label: Freeze LiDAR packet; persist running status
steps.detail: Validate model/provider continuity, evidence and total active capacity.

steps.label: Create fresh camera runner / provider / state
steps.detail: Same locale/model and original RGB+calibration/pose; zero depth dimensions.

steps.label: Original hash-verified JPEGs and calibration
steps.detail: Do not inherit source tracks, physical IDs, corrections, geometry or prices.

steps.label: Gated vision/search requests (F05/F07)
steps.detail: Independent call budget and costs; process each frame, then finish replay.

steps.label: Independent observations / sources / usage
steps.detail: Unknown/error outcomes remain distinct from zero detected objects.

steps.label: Camera packet and processing evidence
steps.detail: Counts, measurement coverage, review reasons, timing and usage.

steps.label: Persist camera packet and comparison report
steps.detail: status complete or failed; analysis_status separately completed/partial/failed/interrupted.

steps.label: comparison_ready {report} via API
steps.detail: Completed/handled failure emits event. Cancellation may persist failure without event; recover through GET.

steps.label: 200 saved report after processing
steps.detail: No 202 response. 409 already_running/source_unavailable/capacity before replay.

steps.label: OPTIONAL GET /api/sweeps/{id}/camera-comparison
steps.detail: Read persisted status; 404 if absent. No replay starts from this GET.

steps.label: 200 persisted running/complete/failed report
steps.detail: Already-running native recovery does one GET; no automatic polling loop.

flows.title: Reprice the same books in a second market
flows.subtitle: Two entry points share one method: voice emits a result event; direct HTTP returns the result without that event.
flows.note: Copies the first ten eligible identified books, or fewer with coverage. Original IDs/frame refs stay the same; primary market prices are unchanged. Direct HTTP validates Locale syntax; voice also validates supported market pairing.

steps.label: PATH A: spoken request through Realtime (F03)
steps.detail: Validated compare_market function arguments: country, currency.

steps.label: compare_market -> second_locale(locale)
steps.detail: Validate supported voice country/currency pair; no separate HTTP round trip.

steps.label: PATH B: POST /api/sweeps/{id}/second-locale
steps.detail: JSON: country, currency; request stays open until results are ready.

steps.label: second_locale(locale)
steps.detail: This is an alternative entry to step 2, not a second call after voice.

steps.label: Copy first ten identified, nonexcluded books
steps.detail: Freeze same physical IDs and frame refs; report required=10 and actual coverage.

steps.label: For each selected book: quote new, then used
steps.detail: Direct sequential quote calls with F07 validation; bypasses pricing-job queue and its resume/dedup rules.

steps.label: Prices with sources or explicit unknowns
steps.detail: Do not overwrite primary-market prices or generate missing identities.

steps.label: Save source evidence and second-locale observation
steps.detail: Persist state; no inventory revision/event or bundle regeneration here.

steps.label: PATH A result: same_physical_ids:true + books
steps.detail: Bridge receives result after awaited pricing.

steps.label: PATH A only: second_locale {result}
steps.detail: Also return function output to Realtime so spoken response can use result.

steps.label: PATH B only: 200 second-locale result
steps.detail: No second_locale WebSocket event is emitted by this HTTP route.

flows.title: Reconnect, recover and account for usage
flows.subtitle: Recovery is bounded and explicit. Files are durable; provider sessions and most processing queues are not.
flows.note: No blanket automatic paid retry. Persisted searching price jobs become interrupted/unknown-cost; eligible queued prices may resume. Server restart does not replay saved frame jobs. Costs can remain partial even when a packet exists.

steps.label: response.done with response.usage; transcription usage
steps.detail: Record actual provider usage once per model/response ID.

steps.label: persist_usage -> save_publish
steps.detail: Sweep path persists metrics; onboarding usage stays in memory until copied at handoff. Unknown usage:null.

steps.label: Atomic state + cost ledger snapshot
steps.detail: Compute known estimated subtotal and uncosted count; unknown is not zero.

steps.label: inventory {packet} via API
steps.detail: Metrics are nested inside packet; no dedicated usage event.

steps.label: ALT provider access/credit or fatal voice error
steps.detail: Selected stale control errors recover; other failures terminate voice bridge.

steps.label: voice_error; review reason saved
steps.detail: Request explicit reconnect/funding action; retain saved camera evidence.

steps.label: User reconnect: close old WS, open new WS
steps.detail: Repeat health/readiness negotiation in F01; no background paid reconnect loop.

steps.label: Current snapshot and newly negotiated voice
steps.detail: Unexpired in-memory setup can survive reconnect, not server restart. Prior provider audio buffers do not.

steps.label: After server restart: GET saved sweep
steps.detail: runner_for loads state; saved capturing/processing changes to partial.

steps.label: Load persisted state and evidence
steps.detail: No durable frame-task broker; missing capture continuity is reviewable.

steps.label: resume_pricing with identity/spend guards
steps.detail: Queued eligible jobs may resume; searching becomes interrupted without replay.

steps.label: 200 current ClaimPacket with review/unknowns
steps.detail: Later price publications use the same event route; no claimed full recovery.
